summary: The @gyomu/infra package serves as a foundational infrastructure layer for the Gyomu ecosystem, providing a consistent service-oriented architecture built on the Effect ecosystem. It abstracts common operational tasks including file system management, database interaction, network communication, and data serialization. By centralizing these cross-cutting concerns, it ensures reliable and type-safe integration across various application components.
responsibilities: Abstract underlying platform-specific file system and network operations.
Provide standardized error handling for I/O and network-related operations using Effect.
Implement consistent service layers for database connectivity and repository management.
Facilitate bidirectional data transformation between structured domain models and common formats like CSV, XML, and JSON.
Standardize application configuration and logging infrastructure.

capabilities.name: File System Operations
capabilities.description: Comprehensive utilities for local file manipulation, streaming, searching, and metadata management with integrated error handling.

capabilities.name: Database Integration
capabilities.description: Abstracted connectivity and repository patterns for Kysely and MSSQL, enabling type-safe CRUD and custom query execution.

capabilities.name: Web and Network Access
capabilities.description: Capabilities for executing HTTP requests, downloading remote content, and processing streamed network responses.

capabilities.name: Data Serialization
capabilities.description: Bidirectional conversion utilities for CSV, JSON, XML, and YAML, often integrating with schema validation to ensure data integrity.

capabilities.name: DOM and Scraping
capabilities.description: Abstractions for parsing, navigating, and querying HTML content, specifically designed for document-based data extraction.

capabilities.name: Security and Authentication
capabilities.description: Utilities for managing JSON Web Tokens and performing cryptographic operations like SHA-256 hashing.

capabilities.name: Archive Management
capabilities.description: Support for creating, reading, and inspecting contents of TAR and ZIP archives through stream-based interfaces.

designDecisions: Leverages the Effect ecosystem for all side-effecting operations to provide predictable, type-safe, and composable services.
Adopts a service-layer architecture to decouple business logic from underlying implementation details.
Utilizes streaming interfaces for large data processing to maintain memory efficiency.
Enforces strong typing for serialization and database operations via integrated schema validation.
Provides standardized wrappers around third-party libraries to ensure uniform behavior and error reporting across the system.
usageGuidance: Prefer using the provided service layers (e.g., FileSystem, TarService) rather than native Node.js modules to ensure consistent error handling.
Always define schemas when using parsing utilities to ensure data consistency at the application boundary.
Use the repository generator for standard database operations to reduce boilerplate and improve maintainability.
Leverage the Effect runtime for composing infrastructure operations to handle failures gracefully through the typed error system.
